title: Foundations of Sustainability
description: Shows how business can be sustainable, profitable and a force for social change. Explores opportunities and challenges for developing more sustainable business strategies and practices, and the changing role of business in relation to society and the environment.
notes: Credit will be granted for only one of MBA 514, MBA 580, MBA 595 (if taken in the same topic).
The unit value of a course section will be specified according to the program in which it is delivered.
